retracted.reason: The keys in this entry were never confirmed against the WASM module and are wrong. hsw's AES is the fixslice (bit-interleaved) soft backend, so the key is never 32 contiguous bytes in memory; the old extractor read a contiguous window out of a scratch region and published whatever was there. The n_key, fingerprint_blob_key and shadow_memory fields were worse than unconfirmed: the n-token is not encrypted under a recoverable key at all. The hsj values came from a heap-entropy scan with no oracle. Entries written by the current extractor carry verified: true and state the oracle that accepted them.
